items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: he became a great friend and we used to correspond, and he sent me records that he’d made.

ctx.x: I met one of them in Atlanta. During my AMA career I went to Atlanta to some kind of a scientific or political meeting, medical, and got to the hotel, The Marriot I think it was, early in the evening, and I heard music downstairs somewhere below the lobby. And there was nothing to do until the next morning so I went down there, and it was the dying moments of a cocktail party. And the man who the party was for was the man who was Secretary of State from Georgia, I’ve forgotten his name now, a well known Secretary…
What was your specialty in medicine — and is your specialty?
